name: TC-AN-QB-012 — 批量填写：超大批量(50+条)性能验证 [P2]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea'); /* 生成50条不合法数据(避免真的写入) */ const largeBatch = Array.from({length: 50}, (_, i) => ({empId: String(900000 + i), empName: `测试人员${i}`})); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, JSON.stringify(largeBatch)); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true, entryCount: largeBatch.length, jsonLength: JSON.stringify(largeBatch).length }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const startTime = Date.now(); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认导入')); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, clickTime: startTime }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasResult = toastTexts.some(t => t.includes('总计')); const modalClosed = !document.querySelector('.ant-modal-root'); return { toastTexts, hasResult, modalClosed, entryCount: 50 }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」\n2. 粘贴50条不合法JSON数据\n3. 点击「确认导入」
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 处理完成时间在合理范围内(<10s)\n2. toast正确展示统计信息\n3. 页面不卡死、不白屏
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
